notes: Seed eval set for Ask Kiara. Each later phase adds its own cases (plan: 'Eval set grows from Phase 1'). 'expected_tools' lists tools that should be called (in any order); 'forbidden_tools' must never be called; 'must_refuse' means the answer must say the user has no access (or cannot answer) and must not contain data the user cannot see; 'expect' lists checks a reviewer applies to the final text. Users refer to the synthetic local seed (README). Phase 2 cases use the synthetic integration fixture (supabase/functions/ask-kiara/integration.fixture.sql): tenant 'Kiara integration' with branches Andheri and Borivali, users kiara-it-01..08@example.invalid (local only).
